title: Bernard Oktoberfest 2008
wikitext:
[[Image:BO08-logo.jpg|right|Bernard Oktoberfest 2008 Logo]] On the 5th of October [[2008]], the last day of that years Oktoberfest, a one day duel tournament was held in the four regular Quakes and in Quake Live Beta. The sponsor [http://www.bernard.cz/ Bernard], a beer manufacturer, awarded the winner of each tournament with a beer glass with the Quake logo on it and a keg of beer. == Introduction == * '''Sponsor:''' [http://www.bernard.cz/ Bernard] * '''Website:''' http://www.quake.cz/?q4=news&iD=1371 * '''Gametype:''' [[1on1]] * '''Number of players:''' 14 * '''Structure:''' Single elimination brackets * '''Admins:''' [[Image:flag_cz.gif]] [[JohnNy cz]] * '''Clients allowed:''' ::[[fuhquake|fuhQuake v0.31 (Build 675)]] with -ruleset smackdown -norjscripts ::[[mQWCL|mQWCL 0.96]] with -noscripts ::[[ezQuake|ezQuake v1.8.2]] or [[ezQuake|ezQuake v1754]] with -ruleset smackdown -norjscripts * '''Map pool:''' [[DM2]], [[DM4]], [[DM6]], [[Aerowalk]], [[ZTNDM3]] * '''Maps to win:''' [[Best of three]], [[Best of five]] (Final) == Results == * 1st - [[Image:flag_nl.gif]] [[Reppie]] * 2nd - [[Image:flag_ru.gif]] [[Bulat]] * 3rd (tie) - [[Image:flag_nl.gif]] [[Purity]] * 3rd (tie) - [[Image:flag_ru.gif]] [[Xpr]] * 5th (tie) - [[Image:flag_cz.gif]] [[JohnNy cz]] * 5th (tie) - [[Image:flag_ru.gif]] [[Witka]] * 5th (tie) - [[Image:flag_cz.gif]] [[Flamer]] * 5th (tie) - [[Image:flag_pl.gif]] [[Blasphemer]] === Quarterfinals === {| border=1 cellspacing=0 cellpadding=4 style="border-collapse: collapse;" width=600 |- bgcolor="efefef" ! align=right|Team #1 !!
